title: Voice readings not (always) completely in English
body:
I am experiencing a bit of a weird issue. I configured Xdrip to enable 'speak readings' when my phone is connected to my cars bluetooth audio.

Since the latest update the trend arrow name is in a different language, while the actual number is always in English. So where I expect to hear eg '8.8 arrow up', it speaks 8.8 in English and the 'arrow up' part in a different one. It sounds like French or Italian or something like that, at least a language I don't speak :-)

My phone is configured in Dutch, but I enabled the 'Force English text' option in Xdrip.

I'm even more confused that sometimes it just works fine and the whole sentence is in English. 

It's not the biggest issue ever, but I would like it if I can get it back to work properly.

Some details:
Xdrip version: [2021.03.08](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.03.08)
Phone: Samsung S9 (Android 10)
Data Source: Libre app

Thanks!

comments.body: Yes, sorry for that. I added it to the description

@wouterlemcke 
I don't think we have a developer who speaks both Dutch and English.
It's always best to recreate the problem and observe it before trying to fix it.  So, I don't think that's possible for us.

But, would you be able to record the spoken words that are wrong and let us hear it?

> Yes, sorry for that. I added it to the description

Please can you confirm that it is working correctly with the nightly build [2021.02.17](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.02.17)?

@wouterlemcke Please respond to the question asked by the developer on August 4.
I close the issue now since there has been no activity.  We can always reopen if the issue persists.
